ev.q: The rate increased an average of 0.16% per year in the Northeast, 0.38% in the Midwest, 0.71% in the South, and 0.27% in the West.
Source: National Vital Statistics System. Mortality public use data files, 1970–2013.
Since 1990, the rates have decreased at an ever faster rate, down on average by 1.41% in the Northeast
The age-adjusted cancer death rates increased significantly from 1970 to 1990 in each census region in the United States.
